name: Excavation Tools
summary: Magmar Fellhew asks you to return tools abandoned when troggs drove the dwarves from their excavation. The tools can help the excavators resume work once the invasion is under control.

sections.title: Tools Left Behind
sections.body: Magmar Fellhew needs the excavation tools the dwarves left behind when troggs overran their camp. You can return them to the excavators, whose work has been stalled by the invasion.

faq.q: Why does Magmar need the excavation tools?
faq.answer: The dwarves left most of their tools behind when troggs overran their camp. The tools will help the excavators work again once the invasion is under control.
Magmar Fellhew is the excavator who asks you to return the abandoned tools.

faq.q: Why did the dwarves leave the tools?
faq.answer: The dwarves had to leave most of their tools behind when troggs overran their camp.
Troggs overran the camp, forcing the dwarves to leave most of their tools behind and halt their work until the invasion is under control.
